fields.title: Daily shop check · 2026-11-03 (sample report, fictional)
fields.summary: Sample report: fictional, an example of what the daily shop check writes. The next check applies the Owner feedback below and marks this report acknowledged. 10 of 12 products are on the website; one of them (Dino Explorer Figures) is out of stock. 12 issues: 2 products not listed, 2 listed without a photo, 2 certificates expired, 3 expiring within 90 days, 2 products missing at least one required certificate type, and 1 order waiting to be confirmed. The live site was not checked because Settings has no live site address yet.
fields.issues:
- [missing-price] Rainbow Xylophone (tt-xylophone): no price, so it is not on the website.
- [hidden-product] Magnetic Building Tiles (tt-magnetic-tiles): status is draft, so it is not on the website.
- [missing-image] Mini Chef Kitchen Set (tt-chef-kitchen): listed without a photo.
- [missing-image] Rainbow Diamond Kite (tt-rainbow-kite): listed without a photo.
- [certificate-expired] Ocean Floor Puzzle (tt-ocean-puzzle): ASTM F963 expired on 2026-09-30.
- [certificate-expired] Bubble Machine (tt-bubble-machine): UKCA expired on 2026-10-20.
- [certificate-expiring] Wooden Train Set (tt-wooden-train): EN 71 expires on 2026-12-01, in 28 days.
- [certificate-expiring] RC Mini Racer (tt-rc-racer): UN38.3 expires on 2026-12-15, in 42 days.
- [certificate-expiring] Ocean Floor Puzzle (tt-ocean-puzzle): EN 71 expires on 2027-01-20, in 78 days.
- [certificate-missing] Mini Chef Kitchen Set (tt-chef-kitchen): no CPSIA / CPC on file (required: EN 71, ASTM F963, CPSIA / CPC).
- [certificate-missing] Rainbow Diamond Kite (tt-rainbow-kite): no ASTM F963 and no CPSIA / CPC on file.
- [orders-waiting] ORD-7K2M9QX4PT (Mia Jensen, 66.50 USD): new since 2026-11-02, not confirmed yet.
fields.site-check: Not checked: no live site address in Settings. Add it after you click Go live.
fields.owner-feedback: Useful. Two changes from now on: warn me about certificates 45 days ahead instead of 90, it is too early to act on. And tell me when a product on the website is out of stock.
